mission.name: HUNT Sustainable Net Profit Mission
mission.rule: The target is a direction and gap metric, never a guarantee and never permission to overspend, over-discount, misprice, or bypass Product Truth / Owner Gate.

extensions.rule: Extend the canonical Profit Engine; do not create a parallel profit brain or truth store.

north_star.label: Verified Net Profit / Hour
north_star.status_rule: UNKNOWN until all required revenue and cost evidence for the hour is complete.

modules.purpose: Rank product opportunity using verified unit economics plus commercial quality.
Propose price/discount ranges above an owner-configured margin floor.
Propose bundles/upsells by expected contribution profit, relevance and fulfillment truth.
Choose the safest expected-profit-positive offer candidate for the current shopper context.
Measure repeat revenue and propose retention opportunities using consented behavior only.
Compare suppliers by landed cost, shipping, reliability, cancellation/return evidence and quality.
Reduce priority when verified return/cancellation economics weaken expected net profit.
Attribute ad/channel cost through orders, margin, returns and repeat revenue instead of ROAS alone.
Propose shelf order using profit quality plus relevance without hiding Product Truth or stock freshness.
Compare controlled variants by verified contribution/net profit before proposing rollout.

hard_guardrails: Never fabricate revenue, costs, profit, conversion, CAC, LTV, return rate or target attainment.
Incomplete cost evidence means net profit is UNKNOWN, not estimated as verified.
Product Truth and fulfillment truth precede promotion.
No autonomous price or discount change.
No autonomous external publish or customer outreach.
No supplier order or payment action from Profit Engine.
Owner Gate is mandatory for material actions.
Growth may not be purchased below the configured margin floor or above the configured CAC/cash limits.
Customer trust, privacy, legal rules and fulfillment quality override the profit target.

milestone_policy.rule: Use evidence-backed milestones instead of pretending the $10,000/hour target is already achievable.
milestone_policy.graduation: Advance only after a sustained verified window defined by Owner; no automatic target graduation.
